s1.prompt: The white service-body truck rolls slowly toward the camera along the gravel road at dawn, dust drifting in the low golden light, headlights on. Low steady camera. Realistic.

s3.prompt: Handheld documentary shot with gentle, minimal camera movement. The technician keeps working inside the open rooftop AC unit with his screwdriver. It never slides or turns. Its screen stays dark. He glances down at the phone, then goes back to his work. Leaves sway; the truck below stays parked. Realistic natural motion. Nobody looks at the camera.
